slides.teacher_cue: Final clusters — consonant pairs at the END of words. Four nasal-based final clusters today: -nd (sand, hand, bend), -nt (went, hunt, mint), -nk (think, tank, blink), -mp (damp, stamp, lamp). The nasal consonant (n or m) comes first, then the stop. Both must be pronounced — do not drop the final stop.
slides.expected_response: Students produce all four nasal final clusters fully — both consonants audible.
slides.correction_move: Model each cluster: -nd (feel the tongue touch the ridge then release), -nt (same but unvoiced), -nk (back of tongue then k), -mp (lips for m then burst for p). Students practise each in isolation before words.
slides.observation_note: Watch for final cluster reduction — Korean syllable structure often closes with a single consonant. Students may produce san for sand, wen for went. Both consonants must be present.

slides.teacher_cue: Hold up your hand. Say hand — -nd final cluster. Reveal and blend. Both n and d must be clear.
slides.expected_response: Students say hand orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model hand orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for final cluster reduction — hand not han.

slides.teacher_cue: Say went — past tense of go. -nt final cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say went orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model went orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the final t — must not be dropped.

slides.teacher_cue: Say think — -nk final cluster. Note: nk = /ŋk/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say think orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model think orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /θ/ onset and /ŋk/ at the end — both phonemes present.

slides.teacher_cue: Say damp — slightly wet. -mp final cluster. Reveal and blend. Both m and p must be clear.
slides.expected_response: Students say damp orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model damp orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -mp final cluster — lips close for m then burst for p.

slides.teacher_cue: Mime stamping. Say stamp — initial st cluster AND final mp cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say stamp orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model stamp orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for st onset cluster and mp coda cluster — clusters at both ends.

slides.teacher_cue: Blink your eyes. Say blink — bl onset cluster AND nk final cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say blink orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model blink orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for bl onset and /ŋk/ coda — clusters at both ends.
